lessons.title: Team reflection: More than a song
lessons.bodyMarkdown:
## When the music fades

Matt Redman describes a season when leadership removed the band and sound system so the church could worship with **only voices and Bibles**. The awkward first week led him to ask: *When I serve, am I offering worship to God—or building my own thing?*

That question is for every worship team member, not just song leaders.

## Discuss or journal

1. What props do we lean on (sound, lights, familiar songs, strong voices) that can hide a dry heart?
2. When you are scheduled to serve, what is one way you prepare your **heart**, not only your part?
3. How can Shanah Worship keep Jesus at the center when we plan services and rehearsals?

## Go deeper (optional reading)

- [Song Story: Heart of Worship — Worship Leader Magazine](https://worshipleader.com/worship-culture/song-story-heart-of-worship/)
- [Back to the Heart of Worship — Desiring God](https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/back-to-the-heart-of-worship)

When you finish, tap **Mark complete** so your progress is recorded.

lessons.title: Team practice: Support, don't compete
lessons.bodyMarkdown:
## For every singer on the team

- **Melody wins.** If you cannot hear the lead vocal clearly, you are too loud or harmonizing in the wrong register.
- **Learn parts at home.** Rehearsal is for blending and cues—not first-time note learning.
- **Match vowels and dynamics.** Unity beats individual brilliance on Sunday.

## This week

Pick one song from our setlist. Listen to the recording, sing your harmony part along with the track twice, then once **a cappella**. Note one phrase where the team usually drifts.

Mark complete when you have done one at-home pass on a song.

lessons.bodyMarkdown:

3. How do we partner with our pastor so music supports the Word?

lessons.title: Scripture + prayer habit for servers
lessons.bodyMarkdown:
## Simple weekly rhythm

1. **One Psalm** — read it aloud slowly; pause on one phrase that matches your heart.
2. **One song lyric** — pray it back to God (try *The Heart of Worship* or a song you are leading Sunday).
3. **One person** — pray for someone on the team by name before rehearsal.

## Go deeper

- [Dwell — singing the Psalms (Paul Baloche)](https://worshipleader.com/leadership/dwell/)

Mark complete when you have done this rhythm at least once this week.
